chapters.label: Live: the 2012 final
chapters.text: The 2012 Futsal Euro final: Russia against Spain, no goals yet. Sergei Abramov shoots from close range, but Luis Amado is already there. Saved!

chapters.label: Replay: the goal-line camera
chapters.text: Watch again. Set before the shot, feet still. The ball hits him, out for a corner. Spain went on to win, three to one!

chapters.label: How he does it (demo)
chapters.text: How he does it: move while the ball moves, and stand between the ball and the middle of your goal. Then the shot comes to you.

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Be in the right place early, and saves become easier. Move first, then set!
